notes.title: Hello Unexpected Heroes
notes.content: [p]If you're dodging twists in Expect the Unexpected, brace for the furry frenzy in Paws Against the World—our fully released indie action game where cute animal heroes like Pelican and Meerkat battle zombie hordes with quirky weapons like Egg Barrage and placeable Cactus traps. And just like your game, PAW packs "unexpected things that can be expected"—think surprise Super Magnet drops or zombie ambushes that keep you on your paws!Why dive in?[/p][list][*][p]Co-op Surprises: Team up with up to 4 players in local shared-screen chaos, full of unpredictable fun.[/p][/*][*][p]Loot Twists: Collect Primal Relics, spin the Slot Machine for random rewards, and unlock permanent upgrades in the Claw Codex.[/p][/*][*][p]Five Difficulty Surges: From chill Pawsy Stroll to twisty Apocalyptic mayhem.[/p][/*][/list][p]Pounce into the unexpected:[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3616450/Paws_Against_the_World/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Paths & Danger, game just release!
notes.content:
Greetings!

For all fans of Dungeons of Hell, we recently released the game Paths & Danger.

Paths & Danger is a procedural turn-based RPG with a more simplistic approach to the tactical genre. Join in on an adventure where you must gather a balanced group of heroes to embark on a series of jobs and quests and uncover the great mystery surrounding the province of Westwall.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1403990/Paths__Danger/


Get Paths & Danger with a release discount of 20% off!
